comparison.objective: Refit a refrigerator door bin onto two hidden supports and push it home; candidate seats a machined workpiece after lifting it with removable hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level carry through narrow side clearance and simultaneous pocket-to-support engagement versus ball-lock pin operation, shackle lifting, suspended-part alignment, support transfer, and extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Both bin ends engaged and locked, level, released, still for 1 s, and not dropped versus retained lift stages, contact on all three fixture pads, complete pin removal, hand clearance, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Both require level transport and multi-support seating, but only the candidate tests temporary load-rated hardware installation, retention, unloading, unlocking, and recovery; both rubrics are complete enough for comparison.
